capture_method: Exact owner-message text blocks were preserved in a local immutable source file and byte-hashed with sha256sum before normalization.
limitations: The conversation surface did not expose durable external message IDs.
The deterministic collector verifies exact local bytes and same-provenance comparison, not independent retrieval from the conversation provider.
The ACCEPT_WITH_REVISION meta-review classifies this receipt as INTEGRITY_ONLY and its independent-source comparison as NOT_INDEPENDENT.
Root completion, release, publication, deployment, or irreversible mutation remains fail-closed if a later mismatch with provider-side owner text is discovered.
